sanskrit: vāgīśvarī tathāsaṃkhyā tathā ca sukulākulātripuraikajaṭā durgā yā cānyā kulasundarīśaivaṃ śāṃkarajātaṃ ca yatkiṃcid bhūtasaṃbhavamjālaśambarambahurūpāṣṭakaṃ jñānaṃ yāmalāṣṭakameva camahādevaṃ vātulaṃ vātulottaram]kalāvādaṃ kalāsāraṃ tathānyat kubjikāmatampañcāmṛtaṃ rūpabhedaṃ bhūtaḍāmarameva casarvajñānātmakaṃ devi ! mahāpitṛmataṃ tathākurūpikāmataṃ devi ! rūpikāmatameva capūrvapaścimadakṣaṃ ca uttaraṃ ca niruttaramaruṇeśaṃ mohaneśaṃ viśuddheśvarameva caśrutvā devi ! na kutrāpi jātānandāsi bhairavitatkathaṃ vada suśroṇi ! mayi tvatpādavartinimanmāyāmudritāśeṣatantrajñānakulārṇavakva brahmā kva hariḥ śaṃbhuḥ kva devaḥ kva manorjapaḥkva rāgaḥ kva sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ kva muktiḥ kva ca sādhutāmāyayācchādya cātmānaṃ tridhā bhūtvā madonmukhīpañcabhūtāni liṅgāni caikottaraśatāni casarve'pyāvirbhavantyatra tato bhāvādikalpanāsarve brahmādayo yūyaṃ madaṃśā bhāvasaṃbhavāḥpañcatvaṃ prāpayiṣyāmi nirvāṇapadalālitāḥahaṃkāraḥ pañcamātrāḥ sattvaṃ cātha rajastamaḥyadi māṃ viddhi sarvajña! kva cāmnāyaḥ kva yājanamnārīrūpaṃ samāsthāya sṛṣṭisāraṃ madātmakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etāvatāpi deveśa ! mama tattvaṃ na jāyateyoganirmuktakānuṣṭha upāyaḥ kathyate mayāsarvasārvajñyadaṃ guhyaṃ tattvabodhaprabodhakamsarvāścaryamayaṃ vatsa ! viduṣāmapi mohanamsadācāryaparijñātaṃ [jñānam] sacchiṣyaparamāspadamna mayā viṣṇave proktaṃ na dhātre gaṇapāya naetattantraṃ vinā vatsa ! nādhikāro'sti [kāraḥ surairapi] yadyapisādhakaḥ prātarutthāya kulavṛkṣaṃ praṇamya caprahlādānandanāthākhyaṃ sanakānandameva cakrodhānandasukhānandau jñānānandamataḥparammahārasarasollāsahṛdayānandalocanāḥkulaśiṣyoparikṛpāpūrṇāntaḥkaraṇodyatāḥevaṃ kulaguruṃ natvā visṛjya kulamātṛkāmśāktaṃ kulaguruṃ vatsa ! kathitaṃ ca sukhāvahamkulanāthaṃ parityajya ye śāktāḥ kulasevinaḥ [parasevinaḥ]tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kulīnaṃ gurumāśrayetdīkṣāprabhuḥ sa evātra sarvamantrasya nāparaḥkṛṣṇaraktaharinnīlā vividhā mama mūrtayaḥdivaṃ sarvamathorvīṃ ca pātālaṃ bhūtasaṃbhavamkulapātre sadūrvaṃ ca satilaṃ sajalaṃ tathākṛtasaṃkalpa evādau kulacakraṃ jale nyasetkulatīrthāni tatraiva samāvāhya kulātmakamkulamūlāya devāya tridhārghyaṃ parikalpya cakulātmakān punardhyātvā kuladevāṃstu toṣayetbhairavāya ca devāya bhairaveṇa ca kartṛṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dātṛdānagṛhītaṃ ca tato liṅgānurūpataḥśrāddhe vivāhe dāne ca snāne cāṅgaprapūjanetatastṛptā tadāśeṣalokān prīṇāmi tattvataḥtilakaṃ kularūpaṃ ca kṛtvācamya samāpya cadvāradeśe tato gītanṛttavādyāditoṣitaḥkulāsanaṃ tataḥ kṣiptvā tadabhyarcya yathāsukhamdehaśuddhyādibhedataḥ]dīkṣitābhiḥ suśīlābhiryuvatībhiḥ kulātmabhiḥnānāvidhāni puṣpāṇi gandhāni vividhāni catāmbūlaṃ deyadravyaṃ ca dhūpadīpādikaṃ ca yatmūlavidyājaptatoyaiḥ prokṣitaṃ sthāpayettataḥpaścime devatāyāṃ ca kuladravyāṇi dhārayetrocanālākṣayāraktaiḥ [lākṣayā laktaiḥ] kuṅkumāruṇacandanaiḥyathāśakti manuṃ japtvā stutvā devīṃ visarjayetkulāmṛtarasaṃ pūrvaṃ [pūrṇaṃ] gurave vinivedayetbrahmarandhre guptasthāne yantralepaṃ tu dhārayetkulīnāya ca dātavyamathavā jalamadhyataḥharināmnā jātabhāvo bhaṅgyanvitaviceṣṭitaḥyāmamātre gate rātrau kulagehaṃ tataḥ pumānkulayantraṃ sādhyanāmnā saṃkulaṃ kulacakrakesvaśaktyā paraśaktiṃ ca samānayati sādhakaḥnijakāntāṃ samānīya suśīlāṃ suyaśasvinīmparānandarasāghūrṇalocanāṃ kulajāṃ satīmnijaputrīvadācāryastadbhālapaṭṭake likhettanmadhye deyamantreṇa darbhitaṃ nāmalāñchitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatastatputrikākarṇe ṛṣicchandasamanvitamadya prabhṛti putri ! tvaṃ kulapūjārcane ratāyathopadiṣṭavidhinā [athopa] sa me vasyaṃ (śyaṃ) samānayatrāhi nātha ! kulācāra padminīkulanāyakagurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā tāmbūlāruṇalocanāsāṅgāvaraṇapūjādau [aṅgāvaraṇa] yadi na kṣamate kulamtarpayitvā tato [kulaṃ dhyātvā] devaṃ japenmantraṃ nirākulamvāmabhāge samāsannaṃ raktavastravibhūṣitamgandhapuṣpadhūpadīpaveṣṭitaṃ sumanoharamjitāmṛtakucadvandaṃ [jitāmita] viśālakarikumbhakamtatskandhe bāhumādāya bhaṅgyā dhṛtakucāvalamkūlākulajapaṃ kṛtvā [kuryāt] samānayati tatkṣaṇātśatayojanadūrasthāṃ nadīparvatamadhyagāmpayodharabharakṣubdhamadhyamāṃ lolalocanāmsādhakākāṅkṣihṛdayāṃ vivarāntaḥprasarpiṇīmsādhakāntaḥsamāsīnāṃ devatāmiva cāriṇīmevamākṛṣṭi siddhiścet sādhakaḥ kauliko bhavetvāmakarṇe parāṃ dadyānmantreṇaivābhiṣecayetvāntānte tripurāyai(tu) hṛdayaṃ parikīrtitamtato gurupadaṃ dadyāt mama śaktipadaṃ tataḥanena manunā deva ! śaktiśuddhiṃ samācaretbrāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā ca kulabhūṣaṇāviśeṣavaidagdhyayutā sarvā eva kulāṅganāḥpretabhūmau bilvamūle haṭṭe vā rājaveśmanitatra saṃpūjya vidhivat kulaṃ kularasena ca [tu]
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato lakṣapradānena siddhidāstā bhavanti hidīkṣitāṃ vastrapuṣpādyairbhojyaiḥ pāyasasaṃbhavaiḥnānāvidhaṃ piṣṭakaṃ ca nānārasasamanvitamupalākhaṇḍacūrṇaṃ ca nānāvidharasāyanamniṣpāvaṃ bījapūraṃ ca dāḍimīphalameva [phalamuttamam] cacandanaṃ mṛganābhiṃ ca śrīkhaṇḍaṃ navapallavam [surapādapam]nānāśailasamudbhūtaṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitam [saṃmitam]amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā śaktīrabhimukhaṃ nayetbrahmāṇyādyaṣṭaśaktīnāṃ nāmabhiḥ kṛtasaṃjñakāḥtathā [tataḥ]dhūpayitvā tataḥ keśān kauśeyaṃ ca nivedayetdatvā tatra samānīya nānālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥtāṃ tāṃ śaktiṃ samāvāhya mūrdhni tāsāṃ samānayetcarvyaṃ coṣyaṃ lehyapeyaṃ bhojyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ nivedayettāsāṃ ca savyakarṇeṣu tataḥ stotraṃ samācaretkṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mama siddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mama siddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā * * * * * * * * * * * * *kṛpayā * * * * * * * * * * * * *kṛpayā * * * * * * * * * * * * *kṛpayā * * * * * * * * * * * * *kṛpayā * * * * * * * * * * * * *kṛpayā * * * * * * * * * * * * *eke bahuvidhe ! devi ! viśvarūpe ! namo'stu tevidagdhāṃ vā samālokya tasya vighnaṃ na jāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dīkṣākāle nityapūjāsamaye nārcayedyadiyadi vrīḍāparāstāstu bhojayettad gṛhādbahiḥācamya mukhavāsāditāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayetnamaskṛtya [visṛjya pradakṣiṇīkṛtya] visṛjyaiva varaṃ prāpya sukhī bhavetagrajā vā mātulānī mātā vā tatsapatnikāpūjyā kulavaraiḥ sarvairnijāhaṃkāravarjitaiḥsaṃskṛtāsaṃskṛtā vāpi jananī vāpi niṣpatiḥekaścetkulaśāstrajñaḥ pūjārhastatra bhairava !ekā cedyuvatistatra pūjitā cāvalokitāādāvante ca madhye ca lakṣapūrtau viśeṣataḥpūrvārjitaphalaṃ nāsti kā kathā parajanmanimamāpi krodhasaṃtāpaśamanaṃ vighnanāśanamprātarutthāya pūjāyāṃ snānakāle'thavā punaḥnamasyāḥ sarvajātīnāṃ kulīnānāṃ kulārcanetadā tatra pīṭhapūjā manasāpi na hīyateyoganidrāṃ kāmarūpe mahiṣāsuramardinīmjālaṃdhare ca pūrṇeśīṃ pūrṇaśaile ca caṇḍikāmathavā kāmarūpasya darśanaṃ yadi bhāgyataḥkulanāthaṃ tato dhyātvā svayamavyagramānasaḥpūjākāle hīnajātā svayoṣidvā prayatnataḥyathā viṣṇuḥ paraṃ goptā yathā ca śaṃbhurīśvaraḥindrādyā lokapālāśca sarve gandharvakiṃnarāḥtairyathā gopitaṃ guhyaṃ tvaduktaṃ śāstrasaṃbhavamtathā tvayaiva goptavyaḥ kulācāraḥ sudurlabhaḥyena hīnā na siddhyanti janmakoṭiśatairapi [kulāḥ koṭisahasraśaḥ]
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: udāracittaḥ sarvatra vaiṣṇavācāratatparaḥ[parvate vipine]devatāyatane caiva nirjane śūnyamaṇḍapekṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā manuṃ japtvā natvā gacchedyathāsukhamkṣemaṃkarīṃ tathā vīkṣya jambukīṃ yamadūtikāmpūrṇodari ! mahācaṇḍe ! muktakeśi ! balipriyeśmaśānaṃ ca śavaṃ dṛṣṭvā pradakṣiṇamanuvrajanghoradaṃṣṭre ! kaṭhorākṣi ! kiṭiśabdapraṇādini !bandhūkapuṣpasaṃkāśe ! tripure ! bhayanāśini !rājaputrakammahiṣaṃ kuladevaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā mahiṣamardinīmmadyabhāṇḍaṃ samālokya matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ varastriyamghoravighnavināśāya kulācārasamṛddhayeraktadhārāsamākīrṇavadane ! tvāṃ namāmyahamśaktimantraṃ puraskṛtya tasya siddhirna jāyatekriyate yadi pāpātmā madbhaktaḥ sa kathaṃ bhavetḍākinyaśca tathā sarvā madaṃśāḥ śṛṇu bhairava !vaṭukānāṃ bhairavāṇāṃ tasya siddhirna jāyateyaṃ dṛṣṭvā yuvatirnārī pūrvadoṣavivarjitādṛṣṭvā madhukaraśreṇī yathā madhumadākulācakorī meghamāsādya sotsukā cātakapriyānavena tṛṇajātena yathā vā hariṇāṅganāmṛṇāladarśanā haṃsī madhulobhātpipīlikāutkṣipya bhujamūlaṃ [mūlasya] ca vasanaṃ kṣipyate punaḥkaṇḍūtibhāvavyājena śithilīkṛtavāsasīskhalatpadayugāpātapatitā punarutthitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etatpraṇayayogena rahasye kāmakalpanāityādibhāvabharitaghṛṇālajjāvivarjitādūtīmukhena lekhairvā jijñāsāsphuritādharākimarthaṃ kimanuṣṭhātā kiṃ vā te'bhimataṃ vadatadā tadbhāvacaturo bhāvabodhahavirbhujetatra sthitvā puraḥkṣobhaṃ kuryāt kāma ivāparaḥtenaiva kulakāṣṭhena yantraṃ kṛtvā tadantarepatre mahiṣamardinyā navavarṇaṃ likhettataḥlikhitvā pūjayedrātrau bhadrakālīṃ samāhitaḥdigvāsā galitāśeṣacikuraḥ kulakaulikaḥsphuracchavakaraśreṇīkṛtakāñcīṃ digambarīmśrutimūlasamākīrṇasṛkkanīṃ caṇḍanādinīmmadirāmoditāsphālakampitākhilamedinīm [sphāra]varābhayayutāṃ ghoravadanāṃ lolajihvikāmśivābhirghorarāvābhiḥ [sphāra] sevitāṃ pralayoditām [praṇavoditām]gṛhītanarakaṅkālairjayaśabdaparāyaṇaiḥevaṃ tāṃ kālikāṃ dhyātvā pūjayet kulasiddhaye [nāyakaḥ]yat kiñcit kulasiddhistu jāyate na manāgapiataḥ sā dakṣiṇā nāmnī triṣu lokeṣu gīyatekālīmantreṇa sādhyādigrathitena ca bhairavavarālṃakāraracito viśet parapuraṃ tataḥsiddhārthaṃ vāmahaste tu gṛhītvā mantramuccaranbhittvā tatra viśedrātrau niḥśaṅkaḥ kṣobhavarjitaḥaśvāgāre rathāgāre kālikāgārasaṃnidhaudhyātvā svapnavatīṃ vidyāṃ [devīṃ] praviśet kāmamaṇḍapam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ke yūyamī vaktavye vayaṃ ca vīrapūruṣāḥtatra pradakṣiṇīkṛtya pitarau paramāspadamdevīkūṭe tathoḍḍīne kāmarūpe tatastaṭeeṣu vinyasya cakrāṇi pūjayitvā praṇamya cajaptvā pīṭhaṃ samādāya bhāṇḍāgāraṃ tato viśetrakṣāpīṭhaṃ puraskṛtya praṇamet pīṭhasaṃmukhamkulapūjāṃ kariṣyāmi upacāraṃ prayaccha mekulapuṣpaṃ [phalaṃ puṣpaṃ] tathā gandhaṃ naivedyaṃ punarāharetsamādāya tathā pūjāṃ kṛtvā paktvā nijecchayāghṛtaṃ madhu tathā cānyad yadvā yatraiva labhyatenijeṣṭadevatāṃ dhyātvā nivedya śāstramārgataḥnivedayet svayaṃ cārdhaṃ bhakṣayitvā puraḥsthitaḥyadi no vidyate yoṣā tatastoye visarjayetpituḥ samīpe saṃsthāpya tattvacintāparo bhavetkāmarūpaṃ praviśyāśu kāmākhyāyonimaṇḍapamsādhyasādhakanāmnā ca darbhitaṃ vipulīkṛtamkāmena kāmayet kāmaṃ kāmaṃ kāmena [kāmī] yojayetmātṛpīṭhe pitṛmukhaṃ sthāpayitvā vidhānataḥkākiṇīṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadyogyaṃ harate haṭhātpaurāṅganānāṃ dravyaṃ vā parirakṣitureva vāteṣāṃ prahāraścāturyaṃ vyabhicārakulakṣatiḥbaddhaścaivābhibhūyateanyacaureṇa vā teṣāṃ kulīnena ca śaṃkara !bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācā vā rākṣasā vā sarīsṛpāḥvidyādharī bhairavaśca vaṭuko gaṇapastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: apatyahāniṃ vikṣobhaṃ vyādhimuñcāṭanaṃ tathāetat purapaterevaṃ tat kāraṇādyadi śaṃkara !tasmāt sarvaprayatnena prabodhaṃ kārayed guruḥvajraṃ śaktiṃ tathā daṇḍaṃ khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ tathāṅkuśampiṣṭakaṃ kadalaṃ deva ! modakaṃ pāyasaṃ tathāviṣṇave paramānnaṃ ca gaṇeśāya ca pīṭhakamkṣetreśāya kṛṣṇacchāgaṃ datvā vīramanuṃ tataḥyathā yajñe'bhiṣikte'śve yathā śakrādibhiḥ suraiḥśayanāgāra aiśāne kulaśaṅkhaṃ nidhāpayetkṛtvā tatra yantrarājaṃ pūjayenniśi sādhakaḥna karoti kathaṃ deva ! sādhakaḥ kauliko bhavetrātrau sthitvā kulācārakathāṃ [kulācāre] tribhuvaneśvarīmprātaḥ snātvā guruṃ natvā pitṝn devān ṛṣīṃstathātato [tataḥ purapateḥ] yuvatisevāyā yatkiṃcidvyapadeśataḥdravyādinā tatra vāpi yathā bhavati bhairava !asyopari kṛpā tasyāḥ kīdṛśī vyapadeśataḥkenāpi vyapadeśena kulacūḍāmaṇiṃ svataḥlikhitvā nijayantraṃ vā kulayantramathāpi vāmadhye tat kulanāmnā ca darbhitaṃ nijanāmabhiḥpūjayet sādhakaśreṣṭhaḥ kulāmnāyaparāyaṇaḥgacchan svadan naman vāpi skhalan viṣṇuparāyaṇaḥsmartavyo'haṃ kulābhijñairaraṇye vā jalāśayetato rātrau śūnyagehe udyāne vā surālayetataḥ pūrvoktarūpeṇa kulakṣobhaṃ samācaret [samārabhet]pīṭhānāṃ paramaṃ pīṭhaṃ kāmarūpaṃ mahāphalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vihāya sarvapīṭhāni tatra [tasyā dehe] putra vasāmyahamteṣāṃ phalaṃ mahādeva ! bahu kiṃ kathyate'dhunāyat pīṭhaṃ brahmaṇo vaktraṃ guptaṃ sarvasukhāvahamsarve'pyāvirbhavantyatra tena guptaṃ mahākulaiḥ [sadā kulam]vyaktād guhyaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ durāpaṃ sādhakottamaiḥguptaṃ sarvatra deveśa ! labhyate kulasundaraiḥputro'smi yadi deveśi ! sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇi !yadārādhanamātreṇa devānākarṣayennaraḥ [yeddhruvam]kālīmantra udāhṛtaḥjaptvā karṣayati svairaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamādikamsuptā nidrāmitā mattā bhrāmitāvanatā [vidrāvaṇaratā parā] tathāniśācāraṃ divācāraṃ saṃdhyācāraṃ ca pallavamjñātvā prabodhayeddhīro gururatraikakāraṇamyadvā tadvā yena kena sarvadā sarvato'pi cayathāyaskāntamātreṇa gūḍhaviddhaśiloccayaḥsūryakāntaḥ spuṭaruciryathā ca raviraśmibhiḥmahādurgāprasādena yathā siddhiśvaro bhavetyathākarṣaṇamātreṇa śiva eva prajāyatetasmāt sarvaprayatnena dīkṣayennijakaulikīmkālikā dakṣiṇā devī caturvargaphalapradāṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena kuryādaṅgādikalpanāmhṛdaye hastayoḥ pādayugale vinyasettataḥpañcadhā dhyānamekatra pūrvoktaṃ ca samācarettatrāvāhya yajeddevīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ kulabhūṣaṇāmkālīṃ kapālinīṃ kullāṃ prathame ca trikoṇake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ugramukhīmugraprabhāṃ pradīptāṃ ca tathaiva cabrahmāṇyādyāstathā bāhye yajet pūrvadale kramātlakṣaṃ rātrau tathā lakṣaṃ mahāśaucaparāyaṇaḥrātrau japaikamātreṇa siddhidā dakṣiṇā bhavetaraṇyāmathavā rātrau mahākālī mahodayāākarṣayeddevakanyāṃ pātāle nāgakanyakāmpūjā dhyānaṃ prayogaṃ ca japaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥjapādikaṃ vāri sarvaṃ pūrvoktaṃ cātra kīrtitamīśāne śaṅkhamāsādya tatra yantraṃ vilikhya caaṣṭottaraśataṃ martyo mantrayitvā susaṃyataḥmadirāghūrṇanayanaḥ parayoṣitsamāgameyannāmnā darbhitaṃ yantraṃ pūjayedvīravallabhaḥmadyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā vatsa ! yat kiṃcit kulasādhanamtadanujñāṃ mūrdhni kṛtvā śeṣaṃ cātmani yojayetjanmāntarasahasrasya sukṛtaṃ tasya naśyatibrāhmaṇastāmrapātreṣu madhu madyaṃ prakalpayetyogibhiḥ pīyate madyaṃ tanmadyaṃ yogipuṃgavaiḥna madyaṃ pānayogyaṃ syādyanmadyaṃ guḍapiṣṭakamānīya devīṃ tad gātre vyāpakaṃ vinyasettataḥvilikhya yantraṃ pūrvoktaṃ pūjayet kulavartmanāmahābhāgāṃ tato mūladevīmāvaraṇaiḥ sahatatpīṭhe yoganidrākhyāṃ pūjayitvā tato yajetkāmarūpaṃ tato gatvā tataḥ kātyāyanīṃ yajettato jālaṃdhare gatvā pūrṇeśīṃ prathamaṃ yajettataḥ pūrṇagirau gatvā yajeccaṇḍīṃ tato japet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tataḥ prānte mahādevīṃ yajeddikkaravāsinīmsaptapīṭhe saptalakṣaṃ japtvā rātrau samāhitaḥevaṃ kṛte vismṛtā cet svanāmni gotrajanmanitataḥ praṇamya deveśīṃ vṛṇuyādvaramātmanaḥakṣobhitakulācāraparicaryāparāyaṇaḥtataḥ prasannā bhavati svairaṃ kulavarapriyārājavṛkṣaṃ samālokya tanmūle sveṣṭadevatāmlakṣapīṭhaphalaṃ deva ! labhate sādhakottamaḥañjanaṃ tilakaṃ guptiṃ mahiṣāsuramardinīmsādhayet sādhako'bhīṣṭaṃ mūlavidyāṃ maheśvara !tanme [tattvaṃ] kathaya deveśi ! yadi sneho'sti māṃ pratibhaumavāre madhyarātrau śavāsanayugāṅkitetatsahasraṃ hunedvatsa ! tatraiva pitṛkānanegatvā durgāṣṭamīrātrau śmaśāne nikṣipettataḥśavāsanagato vīro japedaṣṭasahasrakamsphe'm [sphreṃ sphreṃ] spheṃ daṇḍa mahābhāga yoginīhṛdayapriya !evamāmantrya vetālaṃ yatra yatra prayujyategaccha gaccha mahābhāge ! pāduke ! varavarṇiniaṣṭalohaṃ [khaḍgabāhuṃ] samāsādya pañcāśadaṅgulākṛtimtat sahasraṃ tato japtvā mahāśavakalevarekulāṣṭamyāmardharātre citāmadhye samāhitaḥmadhuratrayasaṃyuktaṃ bilvapatreṇa saṃyutambalyante paramā māyā devī mahiṣamardinīgṛhṇa vatseti śabde vai khaḍgamuttolya dhārayetkāṁ īṁ ūṁ kuru kalyāṇi vipakṣacchedavistaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: chittvā chittvā punaśchittvā gacchatyākṛṣyate punaḥkuje catuṣpathe rātrau nikhanenmantritaṃ tataḥtāvad bhuktvā haviṣyānnaṃ pratirātraṃ japedabhīḥutpannaṃ patramālokya chittvā niśchidramānayettamānīya suhṛtsaṅgaḥ kṣālayenmantramuccarantadānīya yajettatra kālikāṃ ghoraniḥsvanāmsiddhājjano bhavenmantrī nātra kāryā vicāraṇākṛtvā saṃpūjya [tilakamādāya] vidhivat sarvaṃ jayati sādhakaḥkulasthāne samānīya dattvā devyai prayatnataḥbhūmau phūtkāramātreṇa vivaraṃ tatra jāyatetatraiva gamanaṃ tasya bhūtalāntaḥprasarpiṇaḥkāyasaṃkocamāsādya gacchatyavikalo naraḥsiddhayaḥ kulanātheśa ! jāyante na kathaṃcanakulācārasya saṃsiddhyai bhuktimuktiprasiddhayegopyā sarvaprayatnena śṛṇu tāṃ kathayāmi tesṛṣṭisaṃhārakau varṇau vidyā mahiṣamardinīsarvadevasarvasiddhibījabhūtā sanātanītadāṣṭavarṇaṃ vaktavyaṃ na bījaṃ nāpi sādhanametat pūrvasthitā devī gurusiddhivināśinīgurūṇāṃ kulanāthānāṃ mahāśāpapradāyinītrailokyabījabhūtānte sā parā mardinīkulamdattā ca paramā vidyā ṅeyutā hṛdayānvitātasmāt sarvaprayatnena goptavyeyaṃ navākṣarīnārado'sya ṛṣiḥ proktaśchando gāyatramīritamdhyāyet kālīṃ mahādaityayuddharāgamadonmukhīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāme khaḍgaṃ tathā carma dhanustarjanameva capītāmbaradharāṃ devīṃ pīnonnatakucadvayāmoṃ mahiṣa(daitya)śatro hūṃ phaṭ śirasyudīritamoṃ mahiṣaṃ heṣaya heṣaya hūṃ (phaṭ) śikhāmantraḥ samīritaḥmahiṣamardinī hūṃ phaṭ astrāṇi śṛṇu bhairavaāyudhāni palāśāgre yādibhiḥ kramaśo yajetsiddhamantrī tadastrāṇi prayogaṃ ca samācareteṣā vidyā mahāvidyā na deyā yasya kasyacitdīkṣitā kulajātistu siddhidā saiva nānyathāprāptānantarasārṇave mama manohaṃsaściraṃ nandatusevante karivairiṇaṃ kimaribhirbhītirbhavetsevinaḥcchrīmatpādapayojacumbanaparaṃ māmadya saṃbhāvayaśrīmatpādapayojacintanavidhau cittaṃ sadaivāstu naḥmaccitte'kṣatasaṃpadi prasaratu kṣemaṃkari ! kṣamyatāmnmādhvīpūrṇabhavatpadaikakamalāmodena nāsvāditaḥśrīmadbhaktirasātidurdinaparīvāhaḥ sadā sarpatupāṭhaḥ]dṛpyaddaivatavairdāraṇapaṭurjīyājjayāhlādinītruṭyatkhaṇḍavikhaṇḍitākhilaśakuntakṣutpipāsojjvalesmaret iti tantrasāre]dvīrāsphālalasatkarālavadanāṃ ghorāṭṭahāsodbhaṭāmstambhoccāṭanamāraṇādikṛtināṃ teṣāṃ svayaṃ jāyatesteṣāṃ hastagatā bhavanti jagatāṃ mātarnamaste jayapaśya mūrtiṃ na ca dhyānayogyāṃ mama sukhāvahamtripurā bhairavīmūrtirādyā sā parikīrtitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yoginīpūjanaṃ tatra pradhānaṃ kulapūjanamtathā kulatithau durgā pūjitā varadāyinīmāṃsapradhānaṃ naivedyaṃ saṃdhyākāle vidhīyatepaśurūpā samāyāti parivāragaṇaiḥ sahatadaiva maṅgalaṃ tasya nānyathā kulabhūṣaṇa !nityaśrāddhaṃ tathā saṃdhyāvandanaṃ pitṛtarpaṇampaśurūpāṃ śivāṃ devīṃ yo nārcayati nirjanejapapūjāvidhānāni yatkiṃcitsukṛtāni caekayā bhujyate yatra śivayā deva bhairava !paśuśaktirnaraśaktiḥ pakṣiśaktistathaiva [pakṣiśaktiśca bhairava] catena sarvaprayatnena kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ mahatśubhāśubhāni karmāṇi vicintya balimāharetśubhāśubhaphalaṃ vyaktaṃ brūhi gṛhṇa baliṃ tavayadā na gṛhyate vatsa ! tadā naiva śubhaṃ bhavetevaṃ matvā mahādeva ! śāntisvastyayanaṃ caretna kasmaicitpravaktavyaṃ yadīcchecchāśvataṃ sukhamna pituḥ saṃnidhāne vā na mātuḥ saṃnidhau tathāpātālamaṇḍape vāpi maṇḍape vā suyantritekulapuṣpaṃ kuladravyaṃ kulapūjāṃ kule japamkulacakraṃ kuladhyānaṃ sarvathā na prakāśayetprakāśānmantranāśaḥ syātprakāśādeva hiṃsanampūjākāle tu deveśa ! yadi ko'pyatra gacchatiprakāśādyadi guptiḥ syāttatprakāśānna dūṣaṇamkadācidaṅgahānistu na ca vyaktiḥ kadācanaetattantraṃ gṛhe yasya kulākṣarasamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: teṣāṃ gṛheṣu pāpāni duṣkṛtāni bhayādikamlikhitvā kulahastena kuladravyeṇa bhairavasarvathā tasya gehaṃ [dehaṃ] vai na saṃtyakṣyāmi bhairava !etattantrasamāyogāttyājyo na hi kathaṃcanaetadgranthasamāyogāt kapālīkaraṇaṃ yadisaṃpūjya kuladevaṃ ca gṛhṇīyāccaiva nānyathārājyahānirvaraṃ vāpi sutahānistu vā punaḥmanmāyāmohitaṃ cāpi anyadevarato'pi cayathā yoṣiccharīreṇa vicarāmi punaḥ punaḥmahācīnakramaṃ vāpi mahānīlaṃ sadāśivamkulācāraṃ vinā vatsa naiva siddhipravartakamyoginīnāṃ sadā pūjā manasāpi na hīyateabhibhūtisamākīrṇaṃ vyādhiyuktaṃ ca bhairava !saptāhaṃ kramayogena mukto bhavati durgrahātna kasmaicitprayoktavyaṃ pravaktavyaṃ kathaṃcanatvameva vaktā śāstrāṇāṃ na paro'pi maheśvara !kāraṇāvasthayāpannā yadyahaṃ kularūpiṇīkāryabhāvasamāpannā yadāhaṃ viśvarūpiṇīahaṃ viśāmi tvaddehe śaktyā yukto bhava prabhuḥataḥ kārye samutpanne putratvaṃ tvayi vartateatastvameva janako nāstyanyo'pi kathaṃcanakadācitputratāpannaḥ kadācicchiṣya eva hiśivaśaktisamāyogāt kulādermuktikalpanātasmāttvameva sarvatra sarvatrāhaṃ maheśvara !gurustvaṃ yadi śiṣyo'haṃ tadā māstu vivecanā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00402 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
